An agent called a log-search tool and it returned 20 lines; the harness can only fit `budget` lines back into the model's context, so it must truncate. The agent is looking for the term `query` (here 'ERROR') -- the one line that answers its question. The needle is a single ERROR line sitting in the MIDDLE of the result (line 10 of 20), so head-truncation (keep the first `budget` lines) and tail-truncation (keep the last `budget` lines) both drop it, while a relevance-aware truncation that keeps the matching line plus context preserves the answer under the SAME budget. The lines, the query, and the budget are the fixture; which lines survive each strategy is computed.
